name: Seated thoracic rotation
summary: Arms crossed on the chest, turn the upper body as far as it goes each way, hips still.
setup: Sit tall on a chair facing the phone, knees together, arms crossed. Turn the chest to one side as far as is comfortable, return, then the other side.
why: Turning toward and away from the phone changes the shoulder width on screen, but not reliably enough to count. Logged by hand.
tempo: Turn 2 s, hold 1 s, return 2 s.
progression: A stick across the shoulders; a slightly further turn.
contraindications: Sharp pain in the mid-back during the turn.

faults.label: Hips turning too
faults.tip: Squeeze the knees together so the turn happens above the waist.

faults.label: Pulling with the arms
faults.cue: Turn the ribs, not the arms
faults.tip: Yanking on the chair turns the shoulders without moving the spine underneath.

faults.label: Leaning instead of turning
faults.tip: Keep the head level and the trunk tall.

faults.label: Slumping before the turn
faults.tip: Rotation needs a tall spine. From a slump, the mid-back barely moves.
